ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Package Installed - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects installation of suspicious packages using system installation utilities

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\/apt$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/apt\\-get$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*install.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/yum$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*localinstall.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*install.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/rpm$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-i.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/dpkg$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-install.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-i.*")))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*nmap.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ nc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*netcat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wireshark.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*tshark.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*openconnect.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*proxychains.*"))
